description.text: The yard is stacked and covered and the house behind it is full: five at the table, Hesper at the head of it by long-standing arrangement, and an argument about hoop iron that has clearly been running for days and is enjoyed by everyone.

A yard before a house, and the yard is the point: staves in bundles by length, hoops graded on a rail, three barrels standing finished and one clamped up waiting for its head. Inside, five people share two rooms and a table that is always half work and half supper. It smells of oak and steam.

options.text: Step back out to the lane
